title: Browser demonstration verification and fresh Collision AI inference

backend_inference.scope: Direct call to the shipped production inference service predict_from_physics using the loaded v2 artifact; no mock estimator and no screening/provider request.
backend_inference.limitations: This proves technical inference for a synthetic contract fixture. It does not prove model validity, current orbital applicability, or the browser workflow.

frontend_rendering.scope: React server-side component rendering with the actual fresh v2 inference payload and actual maneuver API model payload.
frontend_rendering.limitations: Component markup checks are not browser rendering or page-level interaction.

browser_interaction.scope: No desktop browser executable or CUA browser/app surface was available; no screenshots, navigation, clicks, browser console, or browser-managed downloads were captured.

maneuver_workflow.scope: In-process FastAPI TestClient exercised archived-job restore, the real maneuver API/model, job/event identity, physical candidate results, zero-burn comparison, and PDF responses.
maneuver_workflow.limitations: API-level only; the accepted archive is partial and its TLE source is stale.

reporting.scope: Both job-bound PDF responses were saved and inspected for PDF signature, event/job IDs, maneuver model identity/version, and report provenance strings.
reporting.limitations: Downloads were made by TestClient, not a browser.

environment_and_startup.repository_instructions: README.md documents FastAPI at 127.0.0.1:8000 and Vite at 127.0.0.1:5173; package.json scripts are npm run dev, npm test, and npm run build.
environment_and_startup.startup_result: Both documented services started successfully while binding to loopback. Frontend GET / returned HTTP 200 and the root HTML. Backend GET /openapi.json returned the ORION SSA Research API schema and included the maneuver and job-bound report routes. Provider-backed health/catalog routes were not called.
environment_and_startup.service_lifecycle: Only processes started for this check were stopped after the startup smoke check. No existing unrelated process was terminated. No live screening job was created.

fixture.provenance: Derived from existing backend/tests/test_ai_stage3.py::_physics fixture with an explicit synthetic source tag and is_synthetic=true. It is a deterministic model-contract fixture, not a screened orbital encounter or observed event.
fixture.time_reference: TCA minus screening horizon start, UTC
fixture.state_frame: TEME at TCA; relative features projected to instantaneous primary RTN at TCA
fixture.consistency_checks: Primary TCA state epoch equals TCA. Relative position [1,2,2] km has norm 3 km, matching miss distance. Relative velocity [0,3,4] km/s has norm 5 km/s, matching relative speed. All required vector components are finite.

loaded_model.name: ORION ESA event final log10-risk estimator

fresh_result.semantics: Historical ESA event-risk target estimate, not a calibrated probability or Foster Pc. No high-risk alert was generated.

frontend_component_render.checks: Rendered the fresh v2 model name/version, synthetic event-bound output, target-not-Pc label, RTN frame, all nine feature names with the exact values/units above, and the limitation that the fixed threshold missed all 145 held-out high-risk labels. Rendered the 1.999-day result as unavailable with no prediction. This is static React markup, not browser verification.

fresh_collision_ai_inference.scientific_limitations_preserved: Phase 14.1 found zero of 145 held-out high-risk labels detected at log10 threshold -6. This fixture verifies technical inference only and does not establish accuracy or real-world predictive performance.

checklist_for_a_user_with_a_browser: Start backend with the documented Uvicorn command and frontend with npm run dev; do not invoke provider-backed health/catalog routes unless outbound access is allowed.
In Collision Analysis, verify a fresh eligible v2 result is labelled synthetic/test data, displays its event ID, model v2.0.0, all nine values/units, not-Pc wording, and the threshold limitation.
Select an ineligible event and verify the unavailable status/reason replaces any earlier prediction.
Open Maneuver Assessment for the partial archived job and verify the selected event/job IDs, model score meaning, warning, physical candidate values, zero-burn reference, and unavailable Pc.
Change event/job selection and confirm old rankings disappear; download both reports from the UI and verify IDs and model provenance.
